blocks.text: Known arterial hypertension treated since 2024; cardiology check-up two months ago for chest pain.

Examination revealed central chest pain with radiation to the left arm, occurring at rest and unrelieved by nitroglycerin. Electrocardiogram showed non-specific ST-T changes. Cardiac enzymes were within normal limits. Stress echo was not performed due to patient's inability to exercise. Treatment included sublingual nitroglycerin, oral beta-blocker, and dual antiplatelet therapy. Patient was advised to present to the emergency department immediately if symptoms worsened or persisted.
